checks.meaning: C[t+5]/O[t+1]-1>0 is price-only, engineering five observed sessions, not final user horizon
P(<0)=1-P(>0)-P(=0), zero and missing distinct
All policies start from same t0 information cutoff, cash and universe eligibility
Drawdown eligibility cannot depend on later rebound or trough
Now/wait/cash use same t0-known planned exchange calendar endpoint, not stock actual observed bars or own-entry+H
Confirmation information must be complete before eligible execution; do not backfill completed closing auction or assume a later same-price window/fill; next planned day is proposal only
Latest confirmation/maximum wait must be consistent with execution lag and common endpoint
Quantity must meet lot, eligibility and buy-fee cash constraint; residual cash retained
Shares, cash, receivables and liabilities tracked without duplicate dividend counting
Known no-fill can have a cash wealth path while trade return is NULL; unknown fill not silently cash
Partial holdings and fees retained; no full-fill imputation
Marked NAV/assumed liquidation/actual realized cash clearly separated
Labels enter training only after all required terminal/cost information exists
Direction, trade profitability, cash-relative advantage, wait-relative advantage, risk, execution and maturity distinct
P(D>0), E[D] and constrained action choice are different
Mutually exclusive/exhaustive directions require explicit inclusivity; no missing=neutral
Profit and risk-hit events can overlap and must not be forced to sum to one
Keep every initial intent; report no confirmation, nonfill and non-evaluable coverage
Same-market-path policy simulation is not automatically causal execution evidence
Price and wealth MAE differ; low before intraday entry cannot be used as post-entry low
Identical OHLC can have different barrier sequence and fills
Sell/hold starts with same position and sellability; not complement of empty-account buy probability
Minute ordering and stock/cash/available-position ledger required; daily close features cannot act earlier
Only first priority close-based buy-versus-wait confirmed; H/thresholds/waiting still pending
No actual outcome tables read, new real labels, fits, scores or later target opening
No old draft/engineering source/risk changes; review adds zero variants

user_confirmed_priority: After completed close, decide whether to buy a pullback or continue waiting
timing_review_refinement: Do not make an absolute prohibition of later same-price post-close execution; channel/rule/data/fill eligibility must be separately verified
H=5 synthetic next-day policy: confirmation D4 and entry D5 cannot be automatically sold D5; cash-liquidation and terminal NAV are distinct
check_type: Design correspondence checklist; not executed price/wealth engine validation or forecast evidence
numeric_domain_requirements: Initial cash/wealth denominator must be finite and strictly positive
Execution and marking prices must be finite and strictly positive when required
Share counts and transaction units must be admissible integers; costs finite/nonnegative under declared fee model
Unknown cash/position/fill state is not a numeric zero result
